summary: Parameters pass values into a function, and return sends a result back. Use return when the caller needs the answer, not just printed text.
notes: points=5 is a default. curve(72) uses 5 and curve(98, 10) uses 10.
return min(...), max(...), ... sends back a tuple. low, high, average = ... unpacks it into 3 variables.
The code after a return does not run.
pitfall: Printing inside a function instead of returning gives the caller None. result = show(quiz) stores None.
